name: Pedal power
summary: Many self-powered gym bikes and ellipticals already hold a generator to run their console; that’s a pedal generator half built. Otherwise, put a bike on a stand and drive a treadmill motor from the back tyre. A fit person makes about 75–100W for an hour: enough for phones, lights and radios, not a fridge.

parts.why: Generators already inside self-powered exercise bikes
A treadmill motor driven from the back tyre
Bike dynamos and hand cranks for small loads
Gears pedal speed up to generator speed
Stops the battery spinning the motor

tips: Pedal into a battery, never straight into your devices: the output swings with every stroke.
An hour of hard pedalling charges several phones or runs LED lights for a night.
Gym ellipticals and bikes often hide a generator and a load resistor. Look under the cover.
